options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_fr:
Un système qui peut déplacer la progression plus tôt, pour essayer et empêcher le joueur de se coincer et s'ennuyer tôt.

Un réglage plus bas signifie qu'il reste coincé. Un réglage plus élevé signifie moins se coincer.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_fr:
Définir les règles d'accessibilité de vos objets/emplacements.

**Full:** s'assurer que tout peut être atteint et acquis.

**Minimal:** s'assurer que ce qui est nécessaire pour atteindre votre objectif peut être acquis.

options.name: Packs or Sets
options.doc:
Packs contain cards that are randomized upon receipt at the lua script level
Sets are static card sets (i.e. You received Card Set Lady Luck 4-6)
options.doc_fr: Les paquets contiennent des cartes qui sont randomisées à la réception au niveau du script lua Les jeux de cartes sont statiques (c.-à-d. vous avez reçu le jeu de cartes Lady Luck 4-6)

options.name: Starting Packs
options.doc: If Packs are enabled, sets how many you start with
options.doc_fr: Si les paquets sont activés, indique combien vous commencez par

options.name: Zeroes
options.doc: Toggle whether 0 value card's should be included in the item pool.  Innefective if you are using card packs

options.name: Cure
options.doc: Toggle whether Cure cards should be included in the item pool.  Innefective if you are using card packs

options.name: Early Cure
options.doc: Toggles whether one of the starting locations should contain Cure 4-6?

options.name: Enemy Cards
options.doc: Toggles whether enemy cards should be shuffled into the item pool.

options.name: Starting Worlds
options.doc: Number of random world cards to start with in addition to Traverse Town, which is always available.
options.doc_fr: Nombre de cartes du monde aléatoire pour commencer en plus de Traverse Town, qui est toujours disponible.

options.doc: Forces these items to be in their native world.

options.name: Start Inventory from Pool
options.doc:
Start with the specified amount of these items and don't place them in the world. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}

The game decides what the replacement items will be.
